maria_support: FYI getting customer reports of consistent 502s from hosted API since ~10:12 UTC, multiple customers, high rate. stack: hosted inference -> edge envoy -> auth cache -> backend. can someone pick up? :exclamation:
jonah_sre: on it. first glance from alerting: 502 spike from edge fleet, increased concurrent h2 streams dropped, many upstream RST_STREAM. grabbing traces now.
kevin_runtime: saw a config rollout 30m ago that tightened upstream keepalive and reduced max concurrent streams per connection. i'll check the rollout notes.
tia_engineer: putting healthcheck and routing fallback on standby. can we get a trace id from a customer?
maria_support: provided trace ids: trace-6a9f2b and trace-6a9f3c, customer repro steps: single streaming request to /v1/generate with content-length ~0, http2, client retries disabled.
logbot: [log excerpt] 
```
2024-11-22T10:12:14Z edge-prod envoy[2345]: cluster upstream-host/10.2.3.4:443 envoy error: stream reset: code=RST_STREAM, error=ENHANCED_CONNECTION_ERROR
2024-11-22T10:12:15Z router auth-cache[1182]: auth lookup latency 420ms (p50 15ms) - backend DB throttle
2024-11-22T10:12:16Z edge-prod envoy[2345]: upstream reset while streaming response, returning 502 to client
```
jonah_sre: that looks like upstream (auth DB) latency causing envoys to reset h2 streams when the connection runs out of concurrent stream/window. matches the reduced streams config kevin mentioned.
kevin_runtime: i reverted the keepalive/streams commit on the control plane for the edge pool at 10:20 UTC. rolling restart in progress for canary nodes.
maria_support: customers still seeing errors? one says ~10:25 still getting 502s.
tia_engineer: adding temporary retry policy on edge for idempotent generation calls and increasing connection pool size as hotfix. will apply to a small subset first.
jonah_sre: quick repro locally: 
```
curl -v --http2 -X POST "https://api.redwood-inference.internal/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"stream test"}' --limit-rate 1k
```
kevin_runtime: after revert and pool bump we see successful responses on canary. monitoring shows 502 rate down from 7% -> 0.8% on canary. rolling to 25% traffic.
maria_support: customer on full traffic reported improvement at 10:34 UTC but one large customer still saw intermittent 504s during long streaming sessions.
jonah_sre: digging into large-customer traces: many long-lived responses hit upstream auth cache miss spikes which cause head-of-line blocking. temporary mitigation: enable prefix KV cache warm for auth lookups and increase backend read concurrency. opened ticket INF-4521 to backend team.
tia_engineer: mitigation applied: increased envoy upstream max_concurrent_streams and window; warmed auth cache for top 10 tenants. observing reduced 504s.
kevin_runtime: follow-up: need to revert the change that reduced streams permanently until auth backend properly scales. adding a guard in rollout process.
maria_support: communicated to customer that we applied mitigations and are monitoring. they requested an RCA and ETA for a permanent fix.
jonah_sre: provisional RCA: aggressive edge config change (reduced max concurrent streams / keepalive) + auth backend latency spike -> h2 stream resets -> envoy returned 502/504. mitigation = revert config + increase pool + warm caches + backend scaling.
kevin_runtime: next steps: schedule a postmortem, add automated check for admin-config rollouts that touch h2 params, and improve canary traffic ramp for such changes.
support-bot: Incident severity updated to P2. Mitigation in progress; monitoring for 30m before closure. :white_check_mark:
maria_support: thanks team, i'll draft customer comms and attach traces. closing thread after postmortem created.
